question: Rajeev Janardan is an Indian classical __________ player of the Imdadkhani gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sitar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajeev Janardan is an Indian classical **sitar** player of the Imdadkhani Gharana (school), taught by Bimalendu Mukherjee. 
 
• Rajeev Janardan plays the most melodious and the fastest Sitar, and distinguished Guru of the famous Imdadkhani Etawah Gharana (Musical Tradition).
 
• Pt. Rajeev Janardan is an exponent of Hindustani Classical Music and is recognized as one of the greatest Sitar & Surbahar players of his generation.
 
• Rajeev Janardan is a classical sitar player in the Hindustani style.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Kumar Bose **was the exponent of Tabla.
 
• **Ronu Mazumdar is a well-known exponent of flute** whereas Debu Chaudhuri is an exponent of sitar and Sahafaat Ahmad is an exponent of tabla.
 
• **Pandit Tulsidas Borkar** was the great exponent of Harmonium.
